original_ai_output.title_zh: 专家警告贡贝等州面临严重高温与干旱风险
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 气候变化专家Deborah Ishaku博士警告称，若未采取充分预防措施，预计出现的厄尔尼诺现象可能加剧尼日利亚贡贝州及其他地区的高温胁迫、干旱和粮食不安全。她表示，该现象可能带来降雨延迟、干旱期延长、水资源减少和作物歉收等影响。上述警告来自单一来源报道。

location.raw_text: Gombe State and other parts of Nigeria

key_facts.fact: 气候变化专家警告厄尔尼诺现象可能加剧贡贝州及尼日利亚其他地区的高温、干旱和粮食不安全
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A climate change expert, Dr Deborah Ishaku, has warned that the anticipated El Niño climate phenomenon could worsen heat stress, drought, and food insecurity in Gombe State and other parts of Nigeria, if adequate preventive measures are not taken.

key_facts.fact: 专家称潜在影响包括降雨延迟、干旱期延长、水资源减少和作物歉收
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the potential effects of the phenomenon could include delayed rainfall, prolonged dry spells, reduced water availability and crop failure

key_facts.fact: 厄尔尼诺现象通常每两到七年发生一次，可持续九至十二个月
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the phenomenon typically occurs every two to seven years and can last between nine and 12 months

uncertainties: 上述影响为专家预警，尚未实际发生
目前仅有一个来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
